name: 2000-OPEN-CURSOR
description: Opens a cursor and prepares for processing data in the reporting context.

algorithm.details: Executes SQL block to open a cursor for data access.
Transfers a value into a working-storage field to set up processing.
Performs the 2050-COMPUTE-RANGE paragraph for further computation.

sideEffects.description: Opens and prepares a cursor for database access.
